sw.title: KUMIHAN｜Mizani — Ubunifu wa Kiswahili, wa asili zaidi
sw.description: KUMIHAN｜Mizani ni ujuzi wa AI wa chanzo huria wa kupanga na kukagua tovuti, makala, nyaraka na mawasilisho ya Kiswahili, huku ukihifadhi matini asilia.
sw.lead: KUMIHAN｜Mizani ni mkusanyiko wa ujuzi wa AI wa chanzo huria kwa tovuti, makala, ripoti na mawasilisho ya Kiswahili. Unasaidia kupanga maandishi, nafasi na taarifa kulingana na maana, bila kubadili matini asilia kimyakimya.
sw.concept_body: Kila ujumbe una madhumuni, wasomaji na mazingira yake. KUMIHAN｜Mizani husaidia AI kupanga herufi, nafasi na vipaumbele vya taarifa kulingana na maana, si kunakili kiolezo kimoja kila mahali.
sw.features_deck: Misingi ya kuunda na kukagua maudhui ya Kiswahili.

features.p: Hifadhi tofauti ya ng na ng’, maneno marefu, alama za nukuu na tofauti za uandishi wa namba kati ya maeneo. Usigawanye maneno bila uthibitisho.
Panga ngazi za taarifa na mtiririko wa kusoma kulingana na wasomaji na lengo la kazi.
Usibadili majina, bei, namba, tarehe, alama za maandishi au maana bila ruhusa. Tenganisha mapendekezo na mabadiliko.
Kagua mpangilio, usomaji na mawasiliano bila kubadili faili asilia. Eleza yaliyojaribiwa na yale yanayohitaji uhakiki.

sw.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Mizani haibainishi mtindo mmoja kwa kila kazi. Inatoa maarifa ya kuchagua mpangilio unaolingana na taarifa, chombo na hadhira.
sw.skills_deck: Kuanzia lengo hadi wavuti, nyaraka na mapitio.
skills: Mizani
Bainisha lengo, hadhira, eneo la lugha, chombo na ruhusa za kuhariri kabla ya kuanza.
Web
Mpangilio na usanifu wa Kiswahili kwa tovuti, makala, kurasa za kutua na UI.
Documents
Muundo na usomaji wa ripoti, nyaraka na mawasilisho.
Review
Mapitio ya maandishi na muundo bila kubadili asili.
sw.install_body: Chagua mwongozo wa usakinishaji kulingana na zana yako, kisha uchague ujuzi unaohitajika.
install_notes: Claude / Claude Code: ujuzi na programu-jalizi
Gemini / Gemini CLI: ujuzi na kiendelezi
sw.install_extra: Tazama faili za v0.1.0 na SHA-256 ↗
sw.status_body: Toleo la kwanza lina kanuni 24 na mifano 24 ya kukagua, ujuzi nne na kifurushi cha kila zana. Usakinishaji wa zana, ukaguzi wa wasemaji wazawa na majaribio ya kivinjari havijathibitishwa.
sw.cta_body: KUMIHAN｜Mizani ni chanzo huria na bila malipo. Msimbo, mafaili na historia ya mabadiliko vinapatikana GitHub.
sw.footer_sub: Ujuzi wa upangaji wa Kiswahili kwa ubunifu unaosaidiwa na AI.

en.title: KUMIHAN｜Mizani — Natural Swahili typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜Mizani is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Swahili websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜Mizani is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Swahili websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜Mizani helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Swahili content.

features.p: Protect ng’ and the original apostrophe characters, respect long words, and explicitly select locale formats for sw-TZ, sw-KE or sw-CD.
Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal.
Protect names, quotations, apostrophes, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. Record changes as proposals, never silent edits.
Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Mizani doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief.
en.skills_deck: From scoping the work to web, documents, and review.
skills: Mizani
Scope language, region, intended audience, medium, brand style and authorized edits before designing.
Web
Typography and design for Swahili websites, articles, landing pages, and UI.
Documents
Structure and readability for reports, business documents, and slide decks.
Review
Review typography, information, and layout without editing source files.
en.install_body: Setup varies by tool. Pick the guide for yours, then choose the skills you need.
install_notes: Guides for adding skills, registering plugins, and local installation
Setup guide for Claude Code and Claude chat
Setup guide for Gemini CLI and the Gemini app
en.status_body: v0.1.0 provides four standalone skills and 24 advisory requirements with 24 research fixtures. Native host import, browser rendering and Swahili native editorial review remain unverified.
en.cta_body: KUMIHAN｜Mizani is open source. The skills, releases, and full change history are on GitHub.
en.footer_sub: Swahili typography skills for AI-assisted design.

guide.note: Installation and invocation have not yet been checked in each tool. Some steps may not be available in your environment.
guide.title: Install KUMIHAN｜Mizani in {host}
guide.lead: Choose the full plugin or individual skills, depending on what your tool supports.
sections: Try it without changing the source
guide.format: The plugin contains all four skills. Each skill is also distributed on its own, with its rules and references. Attaching a ZIP to a chat does not install anything.
guide.download: Download the ZIP files from GitHub Release v0.1.0 and compare their SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS.txt before installing.
guide.chatgpt: Use the ChatGPT / Codex plugin only through the plugin import feature your client provides. In Codex, extract each skill into the project’s .agents/skills/ directory. ChatGPT Skills upload depends on your account.
guide.claude: Extract the plugin keeping the kumihan-mizani folder, validate with claude plugin validate and use claude --plugin-dir where supported. Individual skills may be placed in .claude/skills/. Native host support must be verified.
guide.gemini: Extract the extension with gemini-extension.json under kumihan-mizani, then install from that folder with Gemini CLI. Gemini Apps use is a separate, unverified workflow.
guide.test: Specify Swahili locale (sw-TZ, sw-KE etc.), medium, house style and edit permission. Example:
guide.prompt: Use kumihan-mizani-review for this Swahili page. Preserve ng’ and all source text; report confirmed issues and unchecked items separately.
guide.update: Save your customizations, verify the new version and its checksums, then update the way your tool supports. A new commit alone does not update an existing installation. Do not overwrite plugins for other languages.
guide.limits: 24 proposed Swahili checks and a source-byte comparator are supplied. Browser rendering, native host registration, marketplace listing and native editorial review are not verified.

ja.title: KUMIHAN｜Mizani — スワヒリ語のデザインをもっと自然に
ja.description: KUMIHAN｜Mizaniは、AIによるスワヒリ語のWebサイト・文書・プレゼン資料の制作とレビューを支援する、オープンソースのスキル集です。
ja.nav_label: メインナビゲーション
ja.lead: AIとつくるスワヒリ語のWebサイト、記事、報告書、プレゼンテーション。読みやすさも、伝わりやすさも、内容を大切にすることも。KUMIHAN｜Mizaniは、スワヒリ語のための制作・レビュースキル集です。
ja.concept_body: 目的も読み手も違うのに、同じ構成を繰り返さない。文章の意味や情報の優先順位を踏まえて、文字組み・余白・レイアウトを考える。KUMIHAN｜Mizaniは、デザインを画一化するためではなく、一つひとつの制作物をよりよくするための指針を提供します。
ja.features_h2: 伝えるための4つの視点
ja.features_deck: 制作と見直しに共通する、KUMIHAN｜Mizaniが大切にする考え方。

features.h3: スワヒリ語の文字組み
features.p: ngとng’の区別やアポストロフィを守り、長い語の行分けと国別の数値・日時書式を文脈で扱います。
伝える順番と情報の重要度を整理し、目的に合ったレイアウトを考えます。
名前・引用・アポストロフィ・数値・日時・固有名・意味を守り、変更は事前承認と差分を前提にします。
完成物の気になる点を、対象を変更せずに確認・整理するための指針です。

idea_h2: 文字を並べるだけでなく
読む体験を組み立てる
ja.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Mizaniは完成デザインを一律に指定しません。使う媒体や条件に合わせて考えるための知識を提供します。
ja.skills_deck: 制作の入口から、Web・資料制作・レビューまで。
skills: Mizani
用途・読者・地域・書式・編集権限を先に整理します。
Web
スワヒリ語のWebサイト、記事、LP、UIの文字組みとデザインを支援。
Documents
報告書、資料、プレゼンテーションの構成と読みやすさを支援。
Review
制作物を変更せず、組版・情報・デザインの見直しを支援。

guide.gemini: kumihan-mizaniフォルダ内にgemini-extension.jsonがある構造で展開し、Gemini CLIから導入します。Geminiアプリへの取り込みは別手順で未検証です。

guide.check: 任意の静的確認（読み取り専用）：
